# Testimonial: Sweet Truth Dental

[Team Flex](https://learn.flex.dental/author/flex)

How is Flex? Dr. Lauren Poole of [Sweet Truth Dental](https://www.sweettruthdental.com/) on why Flex is a great fit for her new practice:

_"I have just opened my first start-up dental practice and one of the vendor names I kept hearing about was Flex Dental. We chose to use Open Dental as our software service and knew the integration with Flex was one of the biggest selling points. I have been open for a few weeks now and Flex was, by far, one of my greatest decisions. It has made patient communication seamless, payments easy, and my staff is THRILLED with how helpful it is for them. Made by dentists, for dentists. It's wonderful."_

## Get a Flex Demo

Our Flex-perts are the best and brightest the industry has to offer. In fact, when you get a demo of Flex, you'll find that our customer experience managers are not only experts on Flex, but also have years of real-world dental practice experience to share with you!

Want to learn more? You may [schedule a one-on-one session](https://www.flex.dental/demo) with a Flex-pert or reach out to our team by clicking the button below. We are here and happy to help!
